initial_provider_pool.routing_universe: 17913 existing mapped destinations, NOT automatically eligible institutions
initial_provider_pool.ordinary_eligibility: native2021 additive source row, own population observed (including zero), AND at least one strictly-positive dated2021 physical education/healthcare/trade/finance/administration witness OR dated2021 official administrative seat witness OR accepted dated2021 statistical nonrural role
initial_provider_pool.external_eligibility: two explicitly documented ctx:RU-FED-MOW and ctx:RU-FED-SPB context anchors; own NP population remains unknown; fixed context-scaled mass proxy separately marked

local_attachment.rule: directed bounded NP-to-active-provider conditional gravity; protect actual provider cores, other included native source NP chooses maximum gravity within current envelope; ownMi remains fixed; unobserved/unsupported NP retained atomic residual, never invented provider
local_attachment.later_residuals: previously residual atomic units may attach at later candidate caps only with actual directed leaf witness and complete union common-core envelope; previously formed children remain whole
local_attachment.large_city_core_kind: explicit provider_core_seed/large-city source context; no interpretation of every atomic provider as tiny local village

conditional_potential_q.formula: g_ij=Mi_j*exp(-direct_minutes_ij/tau); q_ij=g_ij/sum_k(g_ik) over SAME active provider pool and SAME direct-time budget
conditional_potential_q.self: exclude same canonical ID from denominator and interprovider graph; own core retained structurally, not treated as a trip
conditional_potential_q.outside_option: none; explicitly conditional on observed bounded provider field, not unconditional destination probability
conditional_potential_q.missing: unknown outside bounded or source coverage; q is not observed commuting, never infer nonexistent flow from missing provider index
conditional_potential_q.symmetry: w_ij=sqrt(q_ij*q_ji), require both directed source witnesses; save both q values and directed times
conditional_potential_q.oneway_sensitivity: max(q_ij,q_ji) on union of observed directed support; missing direction retained NA, never relabeled measured zero

aggregate_objective.S: sum_i degree_i = 2*sum unordered atomic w_ij, fixed original graph
aggregate_objective.K_A: sum ORIGINAL degrees of provider seeds in current unit A
aggregate_objective.W_AB: sum unordered original atomic affinities with one endpoint in A and one in B; recompute by exact additive adjacency updates after every union
aggregate_objective.merge_choice: greatest strictly positive admissible delta_Q, lexical stable unit IDs tie-break; lazy priority queue exact; rejected pair can be reconsidered after endpoint union
aggregate_objective.not_attributed_algorithm: weighted modularity objective adapted from Newman-Girvan; this constrained agglomerative potential-graph algorithm is our engineering, not original divisive algorithm or OECD FUA procedure
aggregate_objective.source_witness: every accepted event retains W_AB,K_A,K_B,S,delta_Q,Q,child IDs,source-edge reconstruction keys and actual common core envelope witness
aggregate_objective.graph_support: q denominators use unchanged uniform180-minute active-provider field; at each candidate cap, provider affinity support additionally requires each observed directed contributing route within THAT cap (reciprocal primary requires both directions).
aggregate_objective.fixed_graph_scope: S, original atomic degrees and Q null graph are fixed WITHIN each candidate cap. Candidate-cap support graphs differ, so absolute Q and Q-curve heights are NOT directly comparable across caps; each knee is fitted only within its own cap path.

extent.core: highest fixed intrinsic mass among actual provider nuclei in merged unit satisfying every included native member direct NP-to-core cap; own observed population descending then canonicalID ties; contexts explicitly differently-scoped mass proxy; retain original_provider_seed_ids separately; they are NOT established functional polynuclei
extent.historical_ledger: historical-only memberships preserved outside dated extent and reported explicitly; strict full-axis extent is a separate conservative indicator
extent.unknown: included native member with unknown direct route cannot support affirmative complete envelope; beyondcap distinct from missing
extent.morphology: settlement point network, no invented polygons or claimed continuous built-up morphology

retention.path: publish full positive admissible-merge dendrogram and Q at every merge for each candidate cap; continue next cap from previous full supported forest, so every candidate cut is nested
retention.knee: piecewise linear SSE vs merge index, common breakpoint; min each side=max(10,ceil(.05*n_merges)); earliest index tie; relative SSE improvement>=.25; explicit no-knee for flat/linear/short/unstable paths
retention.bootstrap: 50 fixed-seed geographic-region weight perturbations: multinomial(R;1/R) ordinary-region counts; edge weight multiplied sqrt(b_region_i*b_region_j); context-only anchor multiplier1; fixed ownMi and source graph. This is conditional graph stability, not probability CI
retention.comparison: re-run full constrained coalescence for each weighting and cap. ARI on common positive-weight provider seeds; report compared source-seed count/population/region coverage; at least20 comparable seeds and at least2comparison clusters or replicate unassessable
retention.stable_cut: at least40/50 meaningful assessable knees; medianARI>=.8,p10ARI>=.6,knee merge-fraction IQR<=.15 conditional on that explicit assessable>=80% subset; ALL50 statuses/failure reasons/coverage retained, failure ARI staysNA; strict50/50 separately reported sensitivity, not primary veto
retention.levels: retain only distinct nested admitted stable knee partitions, ordered bottom-up; no imposed number, no target city population bins
retention.fallback: If no stable meaningful knee, publish ALL five supported operational-resolution forests (30/45/60/90/120) with main overview60, all equally inspectable, every actual unit typed; no fake numbered empirical levels. Preserve true source ancestry depth separate from functional rank.
